<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

Data for a database, declared in the project: seeds/*.yaml, applied by &lt;app> seed through the model's use cases (its validations, its defaults). Records written out (categories, settings), each with an alias ($id) others point at, and records generated by the hundred for demos (generate: 500, with rules per field: dates in the past, amounts in a range, values by weight), the same every time. Applying again keeps what is there; --fresh starts over; production is refused.

```esquadro
blueprint seed
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [env](../env/), [domain](../domain/), [postgres](../postgres/), [migrations](../migrations/), [store](../store/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [rest](../rest/) when the app uses them.

## Go modules

- `go.yaml.in/yaml/v3` v3.0.6
